entities.name: Research reference baselines for deep research
entities.summary: Build a source-backed reference portfolio with routed research, provenance, evidence strength, enforceability, and falsifiable adoption experiments.

acceptance: Every recommended method is backed by primary sources and an explicit evidence limit
Reference cards preserve provenance, licensing, trust boundaries, and project-owned authority
The routed workflow separates mechanical retrieval, comparative reasoning, and synthesis
Adoption recommendations include a smallest falsifiable experiment
